name: perl-clone
description: This tool provides a high-performance mechanism for deep-copying complex Perl data structures and objects. Use when user asks to deep copy Perl data types, recursively duplicate nested hashes or arrays, or create independent copies of objects to avoid reference sharing.
overview: The `perl-clone` skill provides a high-performance mechanism for deep-copying Perl data types. Unlike simple assignment which only copies references, this tool traverses the entire data structure to create a completely distinct copy. It is particularly useful for managing state in complex applications, handling nested configurations, or implementing object-oriented prototypes where a "clean" copy of an existing object is required.
